reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested", which is the only reason I'd pick this over the cheap magnesium I already know. The sachets would also live in my bag instead of on the counter where I forget them, but I'd only grab one box, and only if there's a coupon or a flash price.
objection: $1 a day is a lot for something I may not feel at all. Will I actually notice better sleep or fewer cramps, or is it just a nice box?
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon bringing the box to about $22, or a smaller trial pack so I can find out if it works before paying for 30 days.
